text.en: [Alternate Weapon Action]  : When weapon energy is full, consume it before firing to make your next shot deploy a healing turret on impact.

Hold [Reload] at full Charged Edge stacks to fire a sentient <solar/>Healing Turret.

Restorative Turret Properties:
• Lasts 15 seconds
• Targets you and allies within a 30 meters radius once every 3 seconds with healing orbs
• Healing orbs grant x1 <solar/>Cure and x1 <solar/>Restoration for 4 seconds (7 seconds with <solar/>Ember of Solace) in a 7.5 meter radius

Hold [Reload] at full Charged Edge stacks to fire a sentient <solar/>Healing Turret.

Restorative Turret Properties:
• Lasts 15 seconds
• Targets you and allies within a 30 meters radius once every 3 seconds with healing orbs
• Healing orbs grant x1 <solar/>Cure and x1 <solar/>Restoration for 4 seconds (7 seconds with <solar/>Ember of Solace) in a 7.5 meter radius


If <solar/>Touch of Flame is equipped, the turret grants <solar/>Cure x2 and <solar/>Restoration x2 for 6 seconds (<solar/>9 with Ember of Solace)

Hold [Reload] at full Charged Edge stacks to fire a sentient <solar/>Healing Turret.

Restorative Turret Properties:
• Lasts 15 seconds
• Targets you and allies within a 30 meters radius once every 3 seconds with healing orbs
• Healing orbs grant x1 <solar/>Cure and x1 <solar/>Restoration for 4 seconds (7 seconds with <solar/>Ember of Solace) in a 7.5 meter radius


If <solar/>Touch of Flame is equipped, the turret grants <solar/>Cure x2 and <solar/>Restoration x2 for 6 seconds (<solar/>9 with Ember of Solace) to the caster.
